chapterTitle: English Unit 1: Sentence Structure, Syntax & Conditionals (Simple, Compound, Complex & If-Clauses)
subject: english

questions.question: 'Gulrukh loves us like _ mother and guides us like _ able teacher.'
questions.explanation: 'a mother' takes the indefinite article 'a' before a consonant sound, and 'an able teacher' requires 'an' before an adjective beginning with a vowel sound (/eɪ/).

questions.question: He could manage it all by himself.
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (D) Reflexive. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: Why have you done all this?
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Interrogative Adverb. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: I could not make out how to tackle that matter.
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (C) Complex sentence. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: "The cabin beside the lake was already occupied when we arrived."
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (C) beside the lake. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: The word opposite in meaning to the word 'Tardiness' is:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (C) Punctuality. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: Choose the option with correct spelling:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Entrepreneur. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: Identify the example of complex sentence:

options.A: I think about what I am doing later in the day and I daydream.
options.B: I can't go back to school until I recover from flu.
options.C: In The Civil War in America was a turning point.
options.D: The dog is black, white and brown.

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) I can't go back to school until I recover from flu.. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: There are many __________ still believe in superstitions.

options.A: which  B. who  C. what  D. as

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) who. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: Kiran comes home after her interview, runs to her bedroom, and slams the door. You can infer that_________.

options.B: her interview did not go well.

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) her interview did not go well.. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: When the teacher was delivering his lecture, the students were all ears.
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (D) listening carefully. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: After he had finished the work on time, Ali went out for a walk.

options.A: Having been finished the work on time
options.C: Have been finishing the work on time
options.D: Had finished the work on time

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (D) Had finished the work on time. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: Identify the subject complement in the sentence: "The most promising candidate for the position was she."
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) she. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences contains a subject complement?

options.B: The sky turned orange during sunset.

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) The sky turned orange during sunset.. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that includes an object complement:

options.A: The teacher looks tired after the exam.
options.B: The students found the lecture boring.

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) The students found the lecture boring.. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: "He does know how to solve the puzzle, even if he pretends not to." This sentence is best classified as:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) Emphatic. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is not an optative sentence?

options.C: I hope you get well soon.
options.D: She was hoping to win the prize.

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (D) She was hoping to win the prize.. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that is imperative in form but expresses permission:

options.C: Please help me carry this box.

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) Let me borrow your notes.. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: Which sentence shows a blend of assertive structure and emotional force, making it subtly emphatic?

options.A: He was not just tired; he was exhausted.

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) He was not just tired; he was exhausted.. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: She asked me where I was going. What type of sentence is this?
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (C) Complex. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: The children are playing. What type of sentence is this?

questions.question: He goes to hospital for treatment. What type of sentence is this?

questions.question: He went to the market and purchased books. What type of sentence is this?

questions.question: She said that she would help her. What type of sentence is this?

questions.question: She knew that I would help her. What type of sentence is this?

questions.question: The answer which you wrote was not correct. What type of sentence is this?
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (C) Complex. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: Some people live to eat, but some eat to live. What type of sentence is this?
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Compound. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: The boy who is standing in the corner is my cousin. What type of sentence is this?
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (C) Complex. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: Although he worked hard, he did not pass. What type of sentence is this?
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (C) Complex. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.

questions.question: That he would cheat us was not expected. What type of sentence is this?
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (C) Complex. This conforms to official FBISE English HSSC-I standards for Sentence Structure and Conditional Clauses.
